title: Insurance Claim Services Estimating Standard: Pricing and Submitting the Estimate
content:
**Standard.** The claim file must be in opened status when the estimate is submitted. The estimate is priced from the company price list in Xactimate format; on Carrier Program Claim Billing it is reduced by the program pricing discount. General contractor overhead and profit is added, at the tier's overhead and profit percentages of the line-item total, only when the estimate carries at least the tier's minimum number of distinct trades. A Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration file must carry an estimate of at least its minimum estimate amount; a smaller commercial loss is handled under Direction to Pay Claim Billing. The estimate is submitted directly to the carrier on tiers where the company submits estimates and is otherwise delivered to the insured or their public adjuster, within the tier's estimate submission target days of the file opening date.

This is the Insurance Claim Services estimating standard. The percentages, trade minimums, the program pricing discount, the minimum estimate and the target days are each tier's own figures.

## Conditions and effects

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| File status | opened, on the system record, when the estimate is submitted |
| Price basis | the company price list in Xactimate format |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | reduced by the program pricing discount |
| Overhead and profit | added at the tier's overhead and profit percentages of the line-item total, only when the estimate carries at least the tier's minimum number of distinct trades |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | the estimate must be at least the tier's minimum estimate amount; a smaller commercial loss is handled under Direction to Pay Claim Billing |
| Where it goes | to the carrier directly where the company submits estimates; otherwise delivered to the insured or their public adjuster |
| When | within the tier's estimate submission target days of the file opening date |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical rates)

A line-item total of 8000.00 on a tier whose overhead and profit are each 10 percent with a 3-trade minimum: an estimate carrying 3 distinct trades adds 800.00 overhead and 800.00 profit, both taken on the 8000.00 line-item total, for 9600.00; the same lines carrying 2 trades stay at 8000.00.
